schema: Accenture Enterprise Decision Actionability & Safety Contract Specification
organization: Accenture Decision Intelligence Platform / Signal Story
governance_purpose: Enforce deterministic action safety guardrails, operational risk levels, decision preconditions, and human-in-the-loop oversight.
execution_boundary: Advisory decision support only. Automatic or autonomous execution is strictly prohibited.

DRIVER_01_RETURN.recommended_action: Quarantine active inventory batches, initiate RMA root-cause inspection with QA, and audit return reasons.
DRIVER_01_RETURN.expected_business_effect: Arrest customer churn, reduce warranty loss, and identify factory batch defect patterns.
DRIVER_01_RETURN.risk_rationale: Quarantining active inventory restricts fulfillment capacity and may cause temporary out-of-stock conditions if returns are non-defective remorse.
prerequisites: Confirm underlying return sales spike (+420% vs baseline) in ERP financial ledger
Verify RMA return reason codes in warehouse receiving logs
Check batch manufacturing serial numbers against factory QA logs
Confirm replacement inventory availability before issuing quarantine
operational_risks: Unnecessary fulfillment disruption if return spike was customer remorse rather than product defect
Short-term working capital lockup during batch inspection
Carrier return freight processing cost accumulation
DRIVER_01_RETURN.execution_status: Advisory Decision Support — Human Approval Required

DRIVER_02_CHANNEL.recommended_action: Rebalance commercial trade terms, adjust retail distributor incentives, and shift promotional allocation toward high-velocity digital channels.
DRIVER_02_CHANNEL.expected_business_effect: Recapture lost distribution volume, protect channel margins, and optimize partner inventory stocking.
DRIVER_02_CHANNEL.risk_rationale: Modifying trade terms and co-op marketing may affect tier-1 retail distributor relationships if not negotiated collaboratively.
prerequisites: Validate cross-channel sales migration in sales ledger
Review existing master distributor agreement terms and minimum purchase commitments
Confirm digital direct-to-consumer inventory fulfillment readiness
Obtain commercial finance margin impact assessment
operational_risks: Distributor partner pushback on incentive restructuring
Channel conflict between brick-and-mortar retailers and direct e-commerce
Lagged sell-through reporting obscuring inventory buildup in retail channel
DRIVER_02_CHANNEL.required_owner: VP of Commercial Sales & Channel Strategy Lead
DRIVER_02_CHANNEL.execution_status: Advisory Decision Support — Human Approval Required

DRIVER_03_MARKETING.recommended_action: Audit underperforming digital ad campaigns, pause non-converting creative variants, and reallocate budget toward validated conversion channels.
DRIVER_03_MARKETING.expected_business_effect: Eliminate wasted marketing spend, recover blended return on ad spend (ROAS), and improve CAC efficiency.
DRIVER_03_MARKETING.risk_rationale: Prematurely pausing top-of-funnel brand campaigns could reduce long-term organic discovery and downstream assisted conversions.
prerequisites: Confirm ad spend increase (+40%) against conversion decline (-42%) in marketing telemetry
Inspect channel-level click-through and landing page bounce rates
Verify no contractual upfront spending commitments with media agencies
Confirm alternative campaign creative assets are ready for deployment
operational_risks: Loss of top-of-funnel reach and brand awareness momentum
Campaign re-learning algorithm latency upon budget reactivation
Disruption of multi-touch conversion attribution models
DRIVER_03_MARKETING.execution_status: Advisory Decision Support — Human Approval Required

DRIVER_04_PRICE.recommended_action: Deploy targeted promotional discounts, evaluate tactical price-matching bundles, or introduce value-tier product configurations.
DRIVER_04_PRICE.expected_business_effect: Neutralize competitor price advantage, defend product market share, and restore sales velocity.
DRIVER_04_PRICE.risk_rationale: Aggressive price matching risks initiating an unrecoverable price war that erodes gross margins across the entire product category.
prerequisites: Verify competitor price drop (-32%) and price gap (+45%) in competitive pricing feeds
Calculate gross margin floor and unit contribution breakeven under discounted pricing
Confirm channel partner MAP (Minimum Advertised Price) compliance guidelines
Review competitor inventory availability to evaluate whether price drop is temporary clearance
operational_risks: Gross margin compression across existing customer base
Brand equity erosion from prolonged discounting
Retaliatory pricing escalation by primary competitor
DRIVER_04_PRICE.execution_status: Advisory Decision Support — Human Approval Required

DRIVER_05_SUPPORT.recommended_action: Audit 3PL carrier delivery SLAs, surge tier-2 technical support staffing, and issue proactive order status notifications.
DRIVER_05_SUPPORT.expected_business_effect: Reduce ticket resolution time, improve customer CSAT sentiment, and prevent order cancellation churn.
DRIVER_05_SUPPORT.risk_rationale: Over-indexing on vocal complaint volumes without cross-referencing systemic order fulfillment data may misallocate operational resources.
prerequisites: Validate support ticket surge (+310%) and negative sentiment severity in helpdesk logs
Cross-reference carrier delivery tracking timestamps against customer geographic clusters
Confirm technical support queue backlog and escalation routing rules
Verify customer communication templates before broad notification release
operational_risks: Increased support payroll costs from temporary contractor staffing
Carrier relationship friction during SLA breach investigations
Customer anxiety from non-targeted proactive service bulletins
DRIVER_05_SUPPORT.required_owner: Head of Customer Support & Logistics Operations Lead
DRIVER_05_SUPPORT.execution_status: Advisory Decision Support — Human Approval Required

DRIVER_06_DEMAND.recommended_action: Adjust forward production replenishment schedules, scale back category inventory build, and shift commercial focus to resilient product categories.
DRIVER_06_DEMAND.expected_business_effect: Prevent excess inventory buildup, protect operating cash flow, and optimize warehouse utilization.
DRIVER_06_DEMAND.risk_rationale: Over-correcting procurement orders during temporary industry slowdowns could create severe stockouts when market demand rebounds.
prerequisites: Confirm parallel sales decline across all category SKU variants in sales ledger
Review industry-wide market demand indices and macroeconomic indicators
Audit supplier purchase order cancellation penalties and contractual lead times
Verify existing warehouse inventory holding cost projections
operational_risks: Supply chain de-commitment penalties with tier-1 component suppliers
Inability to fulfill unexpected demand recovery due to lean inventory
Loss of category shelf space to competitors who maintain inventory
DRIVER_06_DEMAND.required_owner: Supply Chain VP & Category General Manager
DRIVER_06_DEMAND.execution_status: Advisory Decision Support — Human Approval Required

DRIVER_07_MIX.recommended_action: Realign product SKU assortment, rationalize low-margin variants, and update visual merchandising to highlight high-velocity models.
DRIVER_07_MIX.expected_business_effect: Recover category share, improve blended basket margin, and streamline catalog complexity.
DRIVER_07_MIX.risk_rationale: Rationalizing entry-level base SKUs without checking attachment rates may reduce overall category customer traffic.
prerequisites: Verify variant-level share shift in product dimension and sales ledger
Analyze SKU basket attachment and accessory cross-sell dependencies
Audit retailer shelf-space planograms and digital catalog positioning
Obtain product marketing sign-off on SKU lifecycle phase-out timelines
operational_risks: Unsold legacy variant inventory requiring deep clearance write-downs
Customer confusion from sudden product SKU renaming or phase-outs
Temporary drop in entry-level search engine ranking
DRIVER_07_MIX.execution_status: Advisory Decision Support — Human Approval Required

DRIVER_08_INCONCLUSIVE.recommended_action: Do NOT execute localized operational changes. Maintain baseline inventory, monitor macroeconomic indicators, and schedule cross-functional review.
DRIVER_08_INCONCLUSIVE.expected_business_effect: Prevent false causal attribution, avoid destabilizing operational interventions, and maintain business stability.
DRIVER_08_INCONCLUSIVE.risk_rationale: Taking localized price cuts, marketing halts, or inventory reductions during broad macroeconomic shocks damages profitability without addressing external root causes.
prerequisites: Verify that no single internal operational driver (Marketing, Price, Support, Returns) exceeds materiality thresholds
Confirm market-wide broad-based sales decline across all product lines
Cross-reference external macroeconomic news and regional regulatory conditions
Ensure cross-functional review is scheduled before any tactical policy change
operational_risks: Risk of inaction if subtle internal factors are masked by broad decline
Executive impatience for immediate tactical intervention
DRIVER_08_INCONCLUSIVE.required_owner: Chief Commercial Officer & Enterprise Risk Committee
DRIVER_08_INCONCLUSIVE.execution_status: Advisory Decision Support — Inconclusive Telemetry — No Action Recommended
